stories.story_fr: Le 10 mars 2026 Cintas a signe l'acquisition de UniFirst, consolidation majeure du secteur de la location d'uniformes qui doit elargir la base clients et le maillage des routes.
stories.story_en: On March 10, 2026 Cintas signed the acquisition of UniFirst, a major uniform-rental consolidation set to widen the customer base and route density.
stories.quote: On March 10, 2026, Cintas entered into an agreement to acquire UniFirst Corporation. We are excited about the substantial value we expect to create for shareholders and customers through the UniFirst transaction

stories.story_fr: Au Q3 FY26 Cintas affiche une marge brute record historique dans chacune de ses trois activites route-based, fruit de ses investissements en technologie, capacite et talents.
stories.story_en: In Q3 FY26 Cintas posted all-time-high gross margins in each of its three route-based businesses, reflecting investments in technology, capacity and talent.
stories.quote: Our 8.2% organic growth and all-time high gross margins in each of our three route-based businesses reflect the outstanding performance of our employee-partners and the clear impact of our investments in technology, capacity and talent

stories.story_fr: Cintas maintient une croissance organique a deux chiffres ou proche, entre 7,8% et 9,0% sur quatre trimestres, demontrant la resilience d'un modele d'abonnement recurrent malgre un contexte macro prudent.
stories.story_en: Cintas sustains high single-digit organic growth, between 7.8% and 9.0% over four quarters, showing the resilience of a recurring subscription model despite a cautious macro backdrop.
stories.quote: We delivered another successful quarter with record revenues and strong operating margins.

stories.story_fr: Le segment Other (premiers secours, securite, protection incendie) croit plus vite que le coeur location, +12,9% au Q3 FY26, diversifiant le mix au-dela de l'uniforme.
stories.story_en: The Other segment (first aid, safety, fire protection) grows faster than the core rental line, up 12.9% in Q3 FY26, diversifying the mix beyond uniforms.
